keyword: where is the valspar championship being played
claims: The 2026 Valspar Championship is being played at the Innisbrook Resort and Golf Club - Copperhead Course in Palm Harbor, Florida, near Tampa.
The 2026 Valspar Championship runs from March 17–22, 2026.
The Copperhead Course is a 7,352-yard course.
The Copperhead Course is a par-71 course.
The final round of the 2026 Valspar Championship takes place on Sunday, March 22, 2026.
Viktor Hovland won the 2025 Valspar Championship.
The 2026 Valspar Championship is the final stop of the PGA Tour's "Florida Swing".
